newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, June 10 - Durres - Seven vessels in port of which 6 discharging (2 cement, 1 sugar, 1 flour, 1 general, 1 bulk wheat), 1 loading chrome ore. 3 Vessels in roads awaiting berths, all to discharge, 1 containers, 1 wheat flour, 1 bulk wheat.

BULGARIA, June 2-9 - Varna east, Varna west, Balchik - 37 Vessels in port operating of which 21 loading (2 scrap, 1 cigarettes, 2 cement, 4 soda, 2 clinker, 3 urea, 1 quartz sand, 1 containers, 1 kaolin, 1 tsp, 1 soda/quartz sand, 1 sas, 1 cellulose/granite). 5 Discharging (1 rice, 1 apatite, 1 granite, 2 phosphorite). 2 Discharging/loading (1 rice/general cargo, 1 soy/frozen chicken), 7 discharging/loading containers, 2 discharging/loading trucks/containers. 10 Vessels in roads of which 5 to load (1 kaolin, 2 soda, 1 scrap, 1 cement), 1 to discharge granite, 4 cargo not nominated.

Bourgas - Nine vessels in port operating of which 5 loading (1 ammonium nitrate, 1 steel, 1 gasoil, 1 chemicals, 1 other vessel). 4 Discharging (1 rice, 1 barley, 1 coal, 1 petrol). 6 Vessels in roads of which 2 to load (1 steel, 1 general cargo), 4 to discharge (1 fish, 1 paper, 1 general cargo, 1 crude oil). 12 Vessels due of which 7 to load (1 ammonium nitrate, 2 ammonium sulphate, 1 bentonite, 3 steel). 5 To discharge (1 coal, 1 cars, 1 containers, 1 coke, 1 iron ore).

June 9 - Varna - No labour problems. Varna east - 4 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging. 1 Waiting at anchorage to load. Varna west - 8 Loading at berth, 1 discharging. 2 Waiting at anchorage to load, 1 to discharge. Lesport, tanker port - No vessels. Bourgas - No labour problems. Bourgas east - 5 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging, 12 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 to discharge. 4 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 14 due. Bourgas west - 2 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging. Tanker port - 2 Loading at berth, 1 discharging.

CROATIA, June 9 - Pula - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 under repair/dry-docked. Rasa - One vessel discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth. Rijeka - Two vessels loading at berth, 2 at inoperative berths, 8 under repair/dry-docked, 4 anchored, 5 due. Zadar - Two vessels under repair/dry-docked. Sibenik - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 under repair/dry-dock. Split - Two vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth. Ploce - Three vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth. Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, June 10 - Limassol - Three container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 11 Vessels due 11/6 of which 3 containers, 3 conventional, 5 passenger. No delays expected. Larnaca - One container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging. 2 Vessels due 11/6, 1 container, 1 conventional. No delays expected.

ESTONIA, June 10 - No labour problems. Tallinn City port - 3 Vessels loading at berth (1 pine logs, 1 steel billets, 1 wire rods/steel billets). 3 Due. Kopli - 2 Vessels loading timber at berth, 1 discharging fish. 1 Due. Muuga - 6 Vessels loading at berth (2 fuel oil, 2 fertiliser, 1 peat, 1 boards). 1 Discharging fish, 2 liner vessels. 5 Vessels due. Parnu - Three loading at berth (2 timber, 1 peat), 1 discharging boards. 7 Due.

ITALY, June 10 - Naples - One bulk carrier etb over the next few days, 1 gas tanker etb 11/6. Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa - Commercial port - 1 Vessel in road, no delays. 22 Vessels berthed, 3 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - 1 Vessel in roads, 2 berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 5 vessels berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 6 vessels berthed, 5 under repair/dry-docked. Leghorn - Six vessels in roads, no delays. 32 Vessels berthed. Civitavecchia, Palermo - No vessels in roads, no delays. Gaeta - One vessel in roads, no delays. Naples - One vessel in roads, no delays. Salerno - Three vessels in roads. Augusta - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. Syracuse - Oil harbour - 1 Vessel in roads, 2 berthed. Sarroch - Eight vessels in roads, 1 berthed. Taranto - One vessel in roads. Ravenna, Ancona/Falconara, Venice - No delays. Trieste - Two vessels in roads, some delay

LATVIA, June 10 - No strikes at any port. Riga - 18 Vessels in port of which 17 operating as follows, 5 timber loaders, 2 container loaders, 2 tanker loaders, 2 steel loaders, 1 fertiliser loader, 3 frozen food dischargers, 1 sugar discharger, 1 other general cargo. 1 Vessel waiting. No delays. 18 Vessels due. Ventspils - Five vessels in port, all operating, of which 2 steel loaders, 1 mop loader, 2 miscellaneous. 2 Vessels waiting outer anchorage. No delays. 11 Vessels due. Liepaja - 14 Vessels in port operating. No delays. 3 Vessels due.
LITHUANIA, June 9 - Klaipeda - Three vessels loading (1 timber, 1 oil, 1 steel frame-works), 2 discharging (1 potatoes, 1 fish meal). 1 Vessel loading/discharging. No vessels in roads, 23 due.

POLAND, June 10 - Gdynia - 12 Vessels operating of which 5 loading at berth (3 general cargo, 2 bulkers), 4 discharging (3 general cargo, 1 bulker). 2 Vessels waiting at anchor to load, 1 to discharge, 9 under repair/dry-docked. 42 Vessels due. Gdansk - 15 Vessels operating of which 10 loading at berth (3 bulkers, 4 general cargo, 3 coal). 5 Discharging at berth (1 general cargo, 1 grain, 1 tanker, 2 bulkers). 6 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 2 waiting in roads, 25 due.

PORTUGAL, June 9 - Setubal - Four vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging, 5 under repair/dry-docked. 11 Due of which 6 to discharge, 4 to load, 1 for repair/dry-dock. Leixoes - 10 Vessels operating of which 7 general cargo, 3 containers. No vessels waiting. Vacant places, 1 pier with cranes, 1 pier without cranes. Sines - Four vessels in port operating of which 1 discharging chemical naphtha. 3 Loading (1 unleaded gasoline, 1 aromatic mixture, 1 metallic structures). No vessels waiting. 9 Due of which 6 to discharge (1 coal, 1 butane, 2 crude oil, 1 mtbe, 1 bulk rice). 3 To load (2 propylene, 1 butadiene).

ROMANIA, June 9 - Constanta - 34 Vessels operating of which 25 general cargo (24 loading, 1 discharging). 8 Bulkers (4 loading, 4 discharging), 1 cement loading. 10 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 bulkers (4 to load, 1 to discharge), 2 tankers, 1 cement, 1 general cargo, 1 bagged chemicals (all to load). Constanta south (Agigea) - 10 Vessels operating of which 9 loading general cargo. Midia - One livestock carrier loading, tanker discharging. Mangalia - No vessels.

RUSSIA - BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - June 9 - 20 Vessels operating of which 9 loading (3 non-ferrous metals, 3 fertiliser, 2 general cargo, 1 cellulose). 11 Discharging (4 frozen chicken, 2 containers, 3 fruit/vegetables, 1 rice, 1 sugar). 4 Vessels waiting, 8 due. June 10 - No strikes. Kaliningrad - 11 Vessels in port, all operating, no delays, 4 vessels due. Vyborg - Four vessels in port, all operating, no delays, 7 vessels due.

FAR EASTERN ports - June 10 - No delays/congestion/strikes. Vladivostok - 18 Vessels in port of which 6 loading (1 timber, 5 metal). 3 Discharging (1 soya, 1 coke, 1 sugar), 1 loading/discharging containers, 2 passenger vessels, 6 vessels waiting. Nakhodka - 14 Vessels in port of which 8 loading (4 metal, 1 cotton, 3 timber), 6 waiting. Vostochny - Six vessels in port of which 3 loading (1 timber, 2 coal), 2 loading/discharging containers, 1 waiting. Posyet - One vessel in port loading timber. Zarubino - No vessels.

NORTHERN BASIN - June 10 - Murmansk - Two vessels operating of which 1 alumina, 1 non-ferrous metals. No vessels waiting, 8 due during the week of which 6 loaders (2 non-ferrous metals, 1 aluminium, 2 apatite, 1 iron ore pellets). 2 Dischargers (1 general cargo, 1 cabotage).

BLACK SEA, June 9 - Novorossiysk - 12 Vessels in port operating of which 8 loading (1 coal, 1 scrap, 3 steel, 1 saltpetre, 1 fertiliser, 1 per). 4 Discharging (1 vegetable oil, 1 rice, 2 bulk sugar). 16 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load (1 scrap, 2 steel, 1 copper cathodes. 12 To discharge (6 bulk sugar, 3 bagged rice, 1 containers, 1 onions, 1 counterweights). 43 Vessels due of which 30 to load (2 scrap, 11 steel, 2 tin, 1 copper, 1 zinc, 1 bulk urea, 1 equipment, 1 steel/paper, 1 aluminium, 4 copper cathodes, 1 paper, 4 coal). 12 To discharge (4 bulk sugar, 3 bagged rice, 1 vegetables, 1 bulk stearin, 1 malt, 1 luggage, 1 cars). 1 To discharge/load containers. Oil terminal - June 10 - 1 Vessel berthed to load crude oil, 3 tankers waiting in roads of which 1 crude oil, 2 fuel oil, 5 tankers due, all to load (1 fuel oil, 1 diesel oil, 3 crude oil).

SPAIN, June 8 - Sagunto - 20 Vessels operating of which 11 discharging (10 steel products, 1 lead). 3 Loading (1 steel products, 2 bulk fertiliser). 1 Discharging/loading steel products, 1 discharging/loading containers, 4 ro/ros discharging/loading general cargo. No vessels berthed outside commercial wharf. No berthing delays. Bilbao - June 9 - 20 Vessels operating (3 tankers, 17 dry cargo) of which 4 loading, 14 discharging, 2 loading/discharging. No delays. June 10 - Pasajes - 14 Vessels in port of which 9 discharging (5 scrap, 1 coils, 1 fish, 1 steel, 1 sawn timber). 1 Discharging/loading cars, 4 loading (3 steel, 1 general cargo). No delays. Cadiz - 19 Vessels operating of which 3 ro/ros, 1 cotton, 1 clay, 1 wheat, 1 ship building materials, 1 chloride, 11 under repair. No delays.

TURKEY, June 9 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 8 Vessels operating of which 4 containers, 3 dry cargo, 1 ro/ro. No berthing delays. Galata - 9 Cargo/passenger vessels operating. Port congested. Ambarli - 10 Vessels operating. No berthing delays. June 10 - Mersin - 12 Vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (1 flour, 3 cement, 1 livestock, 1 pumice stone). 3 Discharging (1 timber, 1 vehicles, 1 sodium sulphate). 3 Loading/discharging (2 containers, 1 containers/vehicles). Free zone piers - 2 Vessels discharging (1 sugar, 1 sesame), 1 loading rice. Seka - No vessels.

UKRAINE, June 9 - Mariupol - Four vessels in port operating, all loading (2 fertiliser, 2 steel). 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load (1 sulphur, 3 steel). 1 To discharge/load ferrous metals/steel. 27 Vessels due of which 19 to load (13 steel, 2 fire-clay, 1 fertiliser, 1 coal, 1 ferrous metals, 1 equipment). 5 To discharge (4 containers, 1 sleepers). 2 To discharge/load containers, 1 container not nominated. Odessa - 14 Vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (3 metals, 1 foil, 1 crude oil, 1 urea). 2 Discharging (1 sugar, 1 bananas), 2 passenger vessels, 1 awaiting owner's notification, 3 under repair. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load steel. 16 Vessels due of which 8 to load (5 metal, 1 containers, 1 oil, 1 sun flower seeds). 5 To discharge (2 bananas, 1 cars, 1 paper, 1 containers). 2 To discharge/load containers, 1 passenger vessel. Ilychevsk - 10 Vessels in port operating of which 9 loading (7 steel, 1 pig iron, 1 equipment). 1 Discharging/loading containers. 4 Vessels due
